name: Redemption
overview: Scripture reveals redemption as God's powerful act of deliverance from bondage and evil, demonstrated vividly in His promise to bring Israel out from Egyptian oppression by His outstretched arm (Exodus 6:6). This redemption extends to persons, property, and the firstborn, who are set apart or redeemed as a sign of God's ownership and covenant faithfulness (Exodus 13:11-14). The Angel of the LORD is portrayed as the Redeemer who rescues from all evil, blessing His people and continuing the legacy of the patriarchs (Genesis 48:16). Thus, redemption is both a divine rescue and a sacred setting apart for God's purposes.
